facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports the minister citing the Code du numérique, adopted in 2023, as the legal framework for several digital activities including data and electronic services.

Agence Ecofin reports the minister saying on 2026-09-28 that the Prime Minister had signed the decree creating the Agence nationale de certification électronique, which is to frame electronic certification; the signing date and any link to the Code are not stated.

systems.tiers: national; first operational phase September 2026, 50 enrolment agents trained
